newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pertamina aims to restart Dumai refinery on Mar 21.
newsitem.headline: Pertamina aims to restart Dumai refinery on Mar 21.

text.p: Indonesian state-owned Pertamina plans to restart the 125,000-barrel-per-day Dumai refinery on March 21 after attempts to restart on March 19 failed, industry sources said on Thursday.
"We tried to restart yesterday but we had a small problem. We hope to finish (repairs) today," a source close to the refinery said.
Pertamina shutdown the crude unit on February 22, initially planning a 38-day scheduled maintenance.
The refinery's two 27,500-bpd hyrdrocrackers are expected to be restarted from Friday, another industry source said.
